# 皇帝报告者作用域；只建立本例私有家门人物，actor/recipient别名须由用例显式设置。
tca_test_bribery_prepare_effect = {
    # lane续接有父上下文；用no遮蔽继承值，clear_saved_scope不能阻止父值再次可见。
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_thin value = no }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_generous value = no }
    save_scope_value_as = { name = tca_bribery_lavish value = no }
    clear_saved_scope = tca_bribery_quote
    save_scope_as = tca_bribery_test_reporter
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = tca_bribery_test_actor GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
    tca_test_create_merit_interface_character_effect = { CHARACTER = tca_bribery_test_recipient GOVERNMENT = celestial_government }
    scope:tca_bribery_test_actor = { set_merit_level = 1 add_gold = { value = 5000 subtract = gold } }
    scope:tca_bribery_test_recipient = { set_merit_level = 1 add_gold = { value = 100 subtract = gold } }
}
# 皇帝报告者作用域；归还别名前清理自建人物，私有动态头衔由用例先销毁。
tca_test_bribery_cleanup_effect = {
    scope:tca_bribery_test_actor = { tca_test_cleanup_merit_probe_character_effect = yes }
    scope:tca_bribery_test_recipient = { tca_test_cleanup_merit_probe_character_effect = yes }
    scope:tca_bribery_test_reporter = { save_scope_as = actor }
}
